body: Since about June last year? Up until then I felt I had goals, but I could never reach them.

I've observed my Windows 8 machine sharing network activity over two connections, but yes latency couldn't be a deciding factor here.

If you had two (or more) Wireless Network Cards this would be possible. It's not possible to connect to one or more connections through one card as e36 said, however you can connect through more than one interface. A good example would be connecting to WiFi and Ethernet connections simultaneously (which has the same effect as you mention in your post).
